entries.speaker: Surly Manager
entries.en: ...I dunno, just buy whatever looks[n]interestin' to you.

entries.speaker: Surly Manager
entries.en: Fine, whaddya want? An automatic?[n]A revolver?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, why're you talkin' about cars now!?

entries.speaker: Surly Manager
entries.en: Listen, this here's an enthusiast shop.[n]My regulars'll be mad if I let a casual[n]like you hang around.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm not a freakin' casual! I bought shit from[n]here like, last week!

entries.speaker: Surly Manager
entries.en: You a collector? Heh, you're way more[n]interestin' than blondie over there.

entries.speaker: Surly Manager
entries.en: ...Oh? You guys plannin' a nice big[n]bank robbery or somethin'?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Th-That ain't it! We just like how[n]they look, is all!

entries.speaker: Surly Manager
entries.en: Anyways... you shoulda said before[n]you two're enthusiasts. I'm always up[n]for helpin' fresh faces.

entries.speaker: Surly Manager
entries.en: Don't go 'round pointing 'em at other[n]people. Keep 'em in a bag or somethin'[n]if you're outside.

entries.speaker: Surly Manager
entries.en: Oh, and don't let the fuzz catch wind[n]of you having 'em. I don't need them[n]comin' around here.

entries.speaker: Surly Manager
entries.en: Now, if you look close, you'll be able to tell[n]these're models. Real guns feel... different.

entries.speaker: Surly Manager
entries.en: Maybe someday I'll show you the real[n]good stuff though—if you got the guts[n]for it, of course.

entries.speaker: Surly Manager
entries.en: ...But for now, you get the beginner[n]selection. Just sit tight, I'll bring 'em out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We totally gotta go for some fancy shit,[n]right? I want 'em to shine!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, and here's the cash for mine.[n]Pick me out something good!
